articles.summary: Every year, hundreds of thousands of formerly incarcerated people lose the Medicaid and SNAP benefits that they qualify for, often for routine, clerical issues. What if corrections agencies gave people a way for their information to be shared with benefits agencies, so that people could keep their benefits? We’re thrilled to receive a grant from the latest round of the Public Benefit Innovation Fund (PBIF) to address this challenge.
articles.title: Connecting Corrections and Benefits Data for Successful Reentry

articles.summary: When the Michigan Department of Corrections announced it was updating the way it classifies people in its prisons, with Recidiviz's help, some coverage assumed AI was doing the work. It isn't. Michigan's classification system doesn't use AI, and AI is never used in Recidiviz tools to make decisions about anyone's security level or release. This post explains where Recidiviz uses AI, where we don't, and how we decide.
articles.title: Why We Don't Use AI to Classify People in Prisons
